source_name: Slovenská sporiteľňa – Informácie o banke / Investori / Finančné ukazovatele
why_relevant: Native IR hub of the largest SK retail bank (Erste Group member): annual reports, financial statements, issuer reports. Primary creator of its own earnings disclosures.

source_name: Slovenská sporiteľňa – Aktuality (corporate/earnings press releases)
why_relevant: Dated newsroom carrying full-year and half-year results releases (e.g. FY2025 and H1 2026 profit releases), i.e. the fastest-moving native earnings signal.

source_name: Tatra banka – Finančné správy spoločnosti (o banke / finančné ukazovatele)
why_relevant: Issuer-report hub of Tatra banka (RBI group): annual and semi-annual financial reports in XHTML (ESEF) and PDF — machine-readable disclosure surface.

source_name: Raiffeisen banka (SK brand of Tatra banka) – Finančné ukazovatele
why_relevant: Retail brand operated by Tatra banka; publishes its own financial-indicator/disclosure page, useful for brand-level retail positioning even though the legal entity is Tatra banka.

source_name: VÚB banka – Výročné správy (SK)
why_relevant: Annual-report archive of the #2 SK bank (Intesa Sanpaolo group), reportedly back to ~2004 — the deepest native time series for VÚB.

source_name: VÚB bank – Annual reports (EN mirror)
why_relevant: English mirror of the VÚB annual-report archive — lowers translation cost and confirms terminology mapping SK↔EN.

source_name: VÚB banka – Tlačové centrum (press centre, incl. analytické správy)
why_relevant: Press releases plus VÚB's monthly macro/analytical commentaries — both an earnings channel and a recurring analyst-view source on the SK economy.

source_name: ČSOB Slovensko – Výročné správy ČSOB Finančnej skupiny
why_relevant: Group-level annual-report hub covering ČSOB banka and its SK subsidiaries (poisťovňa, leasing, asset mgmt, ČSOB Real) — bilingual SK/EN documents.

source_name: ČSOB Slovensko – Tlačové správy (pre médiá)
why_relevant: Where ČSOB SK announces group profit and business results (e.g. FY2025 group profit release) ahead of the full annual report.

source_name: ČSOB Slovensko – Informácie zverejňované ročne / štvrťročne (Pillar 3-type disclosures)
why_relevant: Regulatory periodic-disclosure PDFs (capital, risk, exposures) required of SK banks — a standardised, comparable series distinct from marketing-flavoured annual reports.

source_name: 365.bank – Výročné správy
why_relevant: Annual/consolidated reports of 365.bank (ex-Poštová banka), including ESEF filings and sustainability/non-financial statements; the retail challenger with the post-office distribution legacy.

source_name: Poštová banka – Informácie / výročné správy (legacy brand hub)
why_relevant: Legacy-brand disclosure page still live alongside 365.bank; needed for pre-rebrand back-series and to avoid double-counting the same legal entity.

source_name: Prima banka Slovensko – Ročné finančné správy / výročné správy
why_relevant: Annual financial reports (IFRS-EU) of the domestically focused retail bank; PDFs served via a preview-file endpoint. Covers a bank with municipal/regional retail specialisation.

source_name: UniCredit Bank Czech Republic and Slovakia – Správy emitenta / výsledky (SK site)
why_relevant: Issuer reports (half-year/annual financial reports) and bond prospectuses of the CZ-domiciled entity operating in SK via a branch — the only SK-side disclosure surface for this player.

source_name: Slovenská záručná a rozvojová banka (SZRB) – Informácie o banke
why_relevant: State-owned promotional bank (MF SR founder); not retail-universal but publishes its own annual reports and is a policy-linked lender whose disclosures signal state credit programmes.

source_name: Erste Group Bank AG – Financial Reports (parent IR, Slovakia segment)
why_relevant: Listed parent of Slovenská sporiteľňa publishes quarterly segment results and presentations for Slovakia — quarterly cadence that the SK subsidiary itself does not offer, plus forward-looking outlook commentary.

source_name: Parent-group IR of the other SK systemic banks (Intesa Sanpaolo, KBC, RBI)
why_relevant: VÚB→Intesa Sanpaolo, ČSOB SK→KBC, Tatra banka→RBI. Each parent reports quarterly with country/segment detail and analyst Q&A, giving cadence and outlook that SK entities publish only annually.

source_name: Register účtovných závierok SR (registeruz.sk)
why_relevant: Statutory state register where every SK entity — including bank branches like UniCredit's pobočka zahraničnej banky — files účtovné závierky and výročné správy. Catch-all when a bank's own site hides or removes documents.

source_name: NBS CERI – register prospektov a emitentov
why_relevant: NBS registry of approved prospectuses/registration documents; bank registration documents (e.g. SLSP) contain deep business, risk and strategy descriptions not present in annual reports.

source_name: FinStat.sk – bank entity financial profiles
why_relevant: Commercial aggregator normalising SK register filings into per-entity profit/revenue/asset series and listing every filed závierka — fastest way to build comparable multi-bank time series and to resolve historical name changes.

source_name: Slovenská banková asociácia (SBA) – novinky a členská základňa
why_relevant: Sector association covering ~27 members / ~99% of the SK banking sector; its member list is the authoritative actor map for this cell and its news carries sector-level positions and aggregate commentary.

source_name: SITA.sk – company pages for SK banks (agency wire archive)
why_relevant: News agency maintains per-institution tag pages aggregating bank press releases and results coverage — useful for catching announcements that vanish from bank newsrooms and for dating events.

source_name: NBS – zoznam bánk pod priamym dohľadom ECB / dohľad nad bankovníctvom
why_relevant: Regulator's own list of significant SK institutions and branches — defines which banks count as systemic for this cell and disambiguates a.s. vs pobočka zahraničnej banky status.

source_name: Banky.sk – institution directory for SK banks
why_relevant: Directory listing every bank and foreign-bank branch active in SK with links to their official sites — cheap completeness check against the systemic-bank list built from NBS/SBA.

source_name: Erste Group — Key Financials / Financial Data Sheets (XLSX)
why_relevant: Machine-readable spreadsheet of Erste Group's segment reporting, which includes a discrete 'Slovakia' geographic segment (Slovenska sporitelna): P&L, balance sheet, NIM, cost/income, risk costs, loan and deposit volumes per quarter. Highest-value quantitative SK banking series available outside NBS statistics, and already tabular.

source_name: Erste Group Investor Information (IR news releases)
why_relevant: Ad-hoc and results IR news carrying the narrative attribution of group NII/fee moves to specific countries — repeatedly naming Slovakia as a driver. Earliest-timestamped parent statement on SK subsidiary performance, ahead of local SK press releases.

source_name: Erste Group press releases (results commentary)
why_relevant: Group-level press releases on quarterly results and strategy that frequently reference the Slovak market and Slovenska sporitelna; complements the IR feed with more qualitative/strategic framing (pricing, digital, bank levy commentary).

source_name: Erste Group CDN — Slovenska sporitelna standalone investor presentation
why_relevant: Debt-investor presentation for the SK subsidiary, hosted on Erste's group CDN rather than a purely local site: gives SK-only balance sheet, market shares, covered-bond programme and funding detail in English. Demonstrates that group CDN paths (cdn0.erstegroup.com/content/dam/sk/slsp/...) are a harvestable channel for SK-specific documents.
